description: SQLAlchemy 2.x ORM models and Alembic migration. Creates backend/app/models.py with all six tables, backend/app/database.py with a sync session factory, and backend/alembic/ with the initial migration. Depends on FEAT-001 (packages must be installed). Independent of FEAT-003 (routes integration).
steps: Create backend/app/models.py with SQLAlchemy 2.x DeclarativeBase. Define six mapped classes using Mapped[T] and mapped_column() — NOT legacy Column. Tables: (a) users_pg — id UUID PK, email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'reviewer', is_active BOOL DEFAULT True, created_at DATETIME server_default=func.now(); (b) bundles — id UUID PK, owner_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL (FK users_pg.email ON DELETE CASCADE), created_at DATETIME server_default=func.now(), bundle_ref TEXT NOT NULL (temp dir name, diagnostic only); (c) documents — id UUID PK, bundle_id UUID NOT NULL (FK bundles.id ON DELETE CASCADE), filename TEXT NOT NULL, document_type VARCHAR(100), page_count INT DEFAULT 1; (d) findings_pg — id UUID PK, bundle_id UUID NOT NULL (FK bundles.id ON DELETE CASCADE), field VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, decision VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, severity VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, reason TEXT, similarity FLOAT, recommended_action TEXT; (e) review_decisions — id UUID PK, finding_id UUID NOT NULL (FK findings_pg.id ON DELETE CASCADE), reviewer_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, decision VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, decided_at DATETIME server_default=func.now(); (f) audit_log_pg — id UUID PK, ts DATETIME server_default=func.now() NOT NULL, actor_id VARCHAR(255) (nullable — NO email column, use opaque actor_id to avoid PII), action VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, resource_type VARCHAR(100), resource_id VARCHAR(255), outcome VARCHAR(50). IMPORTANT: audit_log_pg must have NO column named 'email', 'name', 'dob', or any PII field — actor_id stores an opaque identifier only. Add a prominent comment: '# Security: no PII stored in audit_log_pg. actor_id is an opaque identifier.' Add __tablename__ to each class. Use uuid.uuid4 as the Python-side default for all UUID primary keys (server_default is not needed for PKs).

Create backend/app/database.py: import settings from app.config; create a sync Engine using create_engine(settings.DATABASE_URL, pool_pre_ping=True); create a SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autocommit=False, autoflush=False); define a get_db() generator that yields a session and closes it in a finally block (standard FastAPI dependency pattern). Do NOT use async engine or AsyncSession — the existing routes are all sync. Add a comment explaining why sync is used here.

Set up Alembic: run `alembic init backend/alembic` equivalent by creating the directory structure manually (the coder should run `cd backend && alembic init alembic`). Then edit backend/alembic/env.py: import Base from app.models, import settings from app.config, set target_metadata = Base.metadata, set config.set_main_option('sqlalchemy.url', settings.DATABASE_URL) so the migration URL always matches the app config. Ensure run_migrations_online uses a synchronous connection (connectable = engine_from_config(...)). Create backend/alembic.ini at backend/alembic.ini (NOT at project root — place alembic.ini at backend/ so `cd backend && alembic upgrade head` works). Set script_location = alembic in alembic.ini.

Generate the initial migration: cd backend && alembic revision --autogenerate -m 'initial_schema'. Review the generated file in backend/alembic/versions/ to confirm all six tables are present. If running autogenerate requires a live DB (it does when using postgresql URL), configure env.py to fall back to sqlite for offline autogenerate: wrap the DATABASE_URL in env.py so that if DATABASE_URL starts with 'postgresql', the metadata comparison still works by using `--autogenerate` against the metadata directly (include_schemas=False). Alternatively, for the initial migration, manually write the migration using op.create_table() calls for all six tables to avoid needing a live DB during plan/test time. The manually-written migration is preferred to avoid CI dependency on a running Postgres. Write the migration file as backend/alembic/versions/0001_initial_schema.py with a hardcoded revision id.

Create backend/tests/test_models.py. Use an in-memory SQLite engine (create_engine('sqlite://', ...)) to test the ORM models without Postgres. Tests: (a) test_all_tables_create — call Base.metadata.create_all(engine), assert all six table names are present in inspect(engine).get_table_names(); (b) test_users_pg_insert — insert a User with a known UUID and email, query it back, assert fields match; (c) test_bundle_cascade_delete — create a bundle with a document and finding, delete the bundle, assert document and finding are gone; (d) test_audit_log_has_no_pii_columns — inspect audit_log_pg columns, assert none of ('email', 'name', 'dob', 'aadhaar', 'pan') appear as column names; (e) test_persist_results_flag_default — import settings from app.config, assert settings.PERSIST_RESULTS is False.
acceptance_criteria: backend/app/models.py defines exactly six mapped classes using SQLAlchemy 2.x Mapped/mapped_column syntax
audit_log_pg table has no column named email, name, dob, or any PII field
backend/app/database.py provides get_db() generator and sync SessionLocal
backend/alembic/versions/ contains exactly one migration file covering all six tables
cd backend && pytest tests/test_models.py -q passes all five model tests
cd backend && pytest -q --basetemp .pytest-tmp passes (all existing tests still pass)
findings: All five model tests pass. Six SQLAlchemy 2.x models created using Mapped/mapped_column (no legacy Column). audit_log_pg has zero PII columns (actor_id is opaque). Alembic initialized at backend/alembic with hand-written 0001_initial_schema.py migration covering all six tables. `alembic upgrade head` with SQLite exits 0. 65 tests pass total (60 pre-existing + 5 new). 7 pre-existing Tesseract/OCR failures unchanged (no Tesseract installed on Windows dev machine, per FEAT-001 findings).
